name: Poodle Walking Backwards on Two Legs — Retromarcia Skills (pending cut 11s-16s)
description: A small poodle walks backwards on its hind legs through the house, perfectly balanced, eyes locked on a treat held in the owner's hand. Transitions from the kitchen to the hallway onto a round grey carpet, ending in a perfect still pose. Classic viral funny-pets moment.
description_alt: Un piccolo cane barboncino cammina agilmente all'indietro sulle sole zampe posteriori attraverso la casa, seguendo ipnotizzato un pezzo di cibo tenuto in mano dal padrone. Transizione cucina → corridoio → tappeto rotondo, finale in posa statua.

metadata.subject: poodle / dog on two legs / backwards / treat-motivated trick
metadata.visual_summary: A small poodle balances on its hind legs and walks backwards through the house, perfectly tracking a treat held by the owner. Ends in a still pose awaiting the final reward. Viral funny-pets content.
metadata.timeline_json: [{"start":"00:00","end":"00:05","visual":"The dog rises on its hind legs in the kitchen and starts walking backwards into the hallway, perfectly balanced, eyes on the treat.","sfx_family":"background_music/bunny_hop"},{"start":"00:06","end":"00:12","visual":"The dog crosses the doorway onto a round grey carpet in the next room, continuing the backwards walk with dancer-like poise.","sfx_family":"background_music_transition/sneaky_snitch"},{"start":"00:13","end":"00:16","visual":"The dog stops at the centre of the carpet, perfectly still on two legs, statue pose; the owner pulls the treat away — cliffhanger finale.","sfx_family":"meme_vocal_effect/comedy_outro"}]

metadata.audio_policy: preserve original clip audio + layer cartoon sfx under at low volume + outro meme vocal
metadata.sound_design_plan: 00:00-00:05 bunny_hop bouncy pizzicato matching the backward steps rhythm; 00:06-00:12 transition into Sneaky Snitch meme theme for the surreal two-legged walk feel (matches the 'skinwalker' title); 00:13-00:16 'Nope' sound effect when owner pulls the treat away + light 'Awww' outro crowd reaction for the statue-pose fade.
metadata.pending_cut_realization: ffmpeg -ss 11 -i <parent.mp4> -t 5 -c copy <cut.mp4>; upload <cut.mp4> to Google Drive (yields new drive_file_id); update this manifest with new drive_file_id + duration_fallback_seconds=5; rerun batch_index_drive_clips.sh --apply. See sibling caveats.md.
